changeSet.author: davdarras
changeSet.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS campaign_daily_stats ( day DATE NOT NULL, campaign_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, organization_unit_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, interviewer_id VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL, nvm_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, nns_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, anv_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, vin_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, vic_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, prc_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, aoc_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, aps_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, ins_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wft_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, wfs_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, tbr_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fin_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, clo_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, nva_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, notice_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, reminder_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, PRIMARY KEY (day, campaign_id, organization_unit_id, interviewer_id) ) PARTITION BY RANGE (day);

changeSet.author: davdarras
changeSet.sql: CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_cds_campaign_day_ou ON campaign_daily_stats (campaign_id, day, organization_unit_id);
